calls.statement:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(f.net_amount) net_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) net_nostaff,
         sum(f.quantity) units_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity END) units_nostaff,
         sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id=999 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) net_999
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net) ref_net, sum(r.quantity_returned) ref_units
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.sku, (SELECT product_name FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=s.sku AND d.is_current LIMIT 1) nm, net_all, net_nostaff, net_999, units_all, units_nostaff, coalesce(ref_net,0) ref_net, coalesce(ref_units,0) ref_units, net_all-net_999-coalesce(ref_net,0) net_after_ret
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (sku) ORDER BY net_all DESC LIMIT 16

SELECT d.business_date, d.store_id, d.net_sales_before_returns rpt_gross, d.returns_net, d.net_sales, x.fact_net, x.fact_net_nostaff
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales d
JOIN (SELECT f.sale_date, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) fact_net, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) fact_net_nostaff
      FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-15' GROUP BY 1,2) x
 ON x.sale_date=d.business_date AND x.store_id=d.store_id
WHERE d.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-15' AND d.store_id IN (1,2,3,4,900,999)
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) fact_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) fact_nostaff, count(*) lines
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-20' GROUP BY 1),
d AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, sum(returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) rpt_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-20' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(x.store_id,d.store_id) store_id, fact_all, fact_nostaff, rpt_gross, rpt_ret, rpt_net, lines FROM x FULL JOIN d ON x.store_id=d.store_id ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 12

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY p.sku),
refunded AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND st.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY p.sku),
names AS (SELECT sku, max_by(product_name, valid_from) AS product_name, count(DISTINCT product_name) AS name_versions FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku)
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refund_net, 0) DESC) AS rank, s.sku, n.product_name,
       round(s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refund_net, 0), 2) AS net_sales, n.name_versions
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN refunded r USING (sku) JOIN names n USING (sku)
ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 12
